guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the supplies and travel share you accept, the days of supplies to hold, the days before a service warning and the repair limit.
Check Supply Items and Stock: the pack, the unit cost, the reorder point and the par level of every item. The stock value, the days of cover and the reorder flag fill in by themselves.
Write every purchase on Purchases and every price on Price History; a supplier price rise shows in the change from last month. Compare other suppliers on Supplier Quotes.
Use the Reorder List to order what is low. A labour hour is one cleaner working for one hour and a crew is the cleaners who work together on a job.
Count the stock on Stock Counts and read the value of the difference. Check each van on Van Stock and write spills and waste on Waste and Spills.
Keep every machine on Equipment with its service date, write each service on Equipment Services and plan the next purchase on Replacement Plan.
Read Jobs, Service Months and Cost per Job by Size to see what each job costs before profit, and Travel Cost by Area to see what the road costs.
Use the 14 calculators when you plan: reorder quantity, days of cover, cost per job, budget, unit price, bulk buy, count difference, replace or repair, dilution, travel cost, van load and price rise.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read the Supplies and Cost Dashboard and the charts every week: spend, cost per job, stock, deliveries, equipment, travel and waste.
Chemical, safety and insurance rules differ by place: check your own local rules before you use any sample wording.

listing.title: Cleaning Business Supplies and Equipment Excel Template: Stock Reorder, Cost per Job, Equipment Service, Van Load, Supplier Prices
listing.headline: Know what every job costs and never run out of supplies
listing.description:
Run the supplies side of a residential and commercial cleaning company in one Excel workbook. Supply Items and Stock hold every chemical, cloth, disposable, protective item and tool with the reorder point, the par level, the stock value, the days of cover and a reorder flag. The Reorder List shows the quantity to order, the supplier, the day you need it and whether a delivery is waiting or late.

Purchases, Price History and Supplier Quotes show what you pay, when a supplier raises a price and which quote beats your current price. Stock Counts turn the difference between the count and the books into money, and Van Stock shows what each crew needs to add before the next job. Waste and Spills and Chemical Safety Notes keep the care of your products in one place.

Equipment holds every machine with its age, its next service date and a warning when it is overdue, Equipment Services records each repair with its cost and downtime, and the Replacement Plan shows the spend for the next 12 months. Jobs, Service Months, Travel Cost by Area and Cost per Job by Size show the supplies, travel and labour cost of every job against its price. 14 calculators cover reorder quantity, days of cover, cost per job, supply budget, unit price comparison, bulk buy, stock count difference, replace or repair, equipment cost per job, dilution, travel cost, van load, price rise impact and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part five of the Cleaning Business suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results. Chemical, safety and insurance rules differ by place: check your own local rules.

ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.

es.Use the Reorder List to order what is lo: Utilice el Lista de reordenamiento para ordenar lo que está bajo. Una hora de trabajo es un limpiador que trabaja durante una hora y una cuadrilla son los limpiadores que trabajan juntos en un trabajo.
es.Count the stock on Stock Counts and read: Cuente las acciones en Recuento de existencias y lea el valor de la diferencia. Marque cada camioneta en Stock de furgonetas y escriba derrames y desechos en Residuos y derrames.
es.Keep every machine on Equipment with its: Mantenga cada máquina en Equipo con su fecha de servicio, escriba cada servicio el Servicios de equipos y planifique la próxima compra el Plan de reemplazo.
es.Read Jobs, Service Months and Cost per J: Lea Empleos, Meses de servicio y Costo por trabajo por tamaño para ver cuánto cuesta cada trabajo antes de obtener beneficios, y Costo de viaje por área para ver cuánto cuesta el camino.
es.Use the 14 calculators when you plan: re: Utilice las 14 calculadoras cuando planifique: cantidad de reorden, días de cobertura, costo por trabajo, presupuesto, precio unitario, compra al por mayor, diferencia de conteo, reemplazo o reparación, dilución, costo de viaje, carga de camioneta y aumento de precio.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para abrir un chat con el texto ya escrito (28 mensajes).
es.Read the Supplies and Cost Dashboard and: Lea el Panel de suministros y costos y los gráficos cada semana: gasto, costo por trabajo, existencias, entregas, equipos, viajes y desperdicios.
es.Chemical, safety and insurance rules dif: Las normas químicas, de seguridad y de seguros difieren según el lugar: consulte sus propias normas locales antes de utilizar cualquier texto de muestra.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.
